metadata.description: Session-rail mods for Claude Code: one session pane with a plan usage card and a todo stack that survives compaction.

plugins.name: session-rail
plugins.description: One session pane that other mods add cards to, with a button at the right of the prompt footer to open and close it.

plugins.name: usage-rail
plugins.description: Adds a usage card to the session pane: session limit, weekly limit and cloud session credit, as the app's usage card shows them.

plugins.name: todo-stack
plugins.description: Adds a todo card to the session pane that keeps every todo the model creates on one stack shared by every session, newest on top, so none is lost to compaction, a reload or a new session; the model reads and edits it through a todos tool.
